title: Global commodity and equity markets spillovers to Africa during the COVID-19 pandemic
summary: The study examines connectedness between 12 African equity markets and global commodity and developed equity markets, with a focus on the peak of the COVID-19 pandemic.
keyFindings: African equity markets are weakly connected to global markets, but connectedness rose notably during the pandemic.
Energy markets dominate shock transmission within the commodity system.
France transmits the largest equity spillover over the full sample; South Africa does so during the pandemic peak.
